name: Néstor Luis Reverol Torres

name: Tarek William Saab Halabi
reason: Venezuelan Attorney General appointed by the Constituent Assembly. name: Jesús Rafael Suárez Chourio
reason: Commander in Chief of the Venezuelan Bolivarian National Army and Chief of the General Staff to the Commander‐in‐Chief. name: Elías José Jaua Milano
reason: Former Minister of Popular Power for Education. Former President of the Presidential Commission for the illegitimate National Constituent Assembly. Responsible for undermining democracy and the rule of law in Venezuela through his role in leading the establishment of the illegitimate Constituent Assembly.

name: Freddy Alirio Bernal Rosales
